metadata.name: Enterprise RAG: Proposal Generation & Compliance Auditor
metadata.description: Industrial-grade dual-stage Agentic RAG: Private KB retrieval ➔ Grounded proposal draft ➔ Fact-checking & hallucination audit ➔ Audited deliverable.
metadata.author: PatchCat Team

data.label: Client Requirement Input
data.description: Receives enterprise technical requirement and compliance constraints

inputs.client_requirement: Our microservice workflow cluster recently suffered from deadlock caused by cyclical graph configurations. Based on PatchCat core architecture, explain how PatchCat detects DAG cycle deadlocks and its algorithmic principle. Furthermore, what optimizations are implemented to prevent UI lag with large node sets?

data.label: Architecture Whitepaper Retrieval
data.description: Retrieves algorithm and performance specifications from PatchCat knowledge base

data.label: Proposal Generator Prompt
data.description: Injects retrieved knowledge citations to draft technical architecture proposal

data.label: Proposal Generator (LLM)
data.description: Generates initial architectural proposal grounded in retrieved chunks

data.label: Compliance & Hallucination Audit Prompt
data.description: Performs dual-input factual verification against raw knowledge chunks

data.label: Compliance & Fact Auditor (LLM)
data.description: Audits proposal against knowledge ground truth with scoring and feedback

data.label: Final Audited Proposal Report
data.description: Consolidates proposal draft, compliance audit report, and citation references
